column1: 20293§pinpoint§ˈpɪnpɔɪnt§The latest research pinpoints for the first time a molecular mechanism in plants that reacts to temperature—often triggering the buds of spring we long to see at the end of winter.§最新的研究首次**确定**了植物中对温度做出反应的分子机制，常常会触发我们在冬天结束时渴望看到的春之萌芽。§
20294§pulley§ˈpʊli§The lifting device is a rope and pulley system.§这种起重装置是由缆索和**滑轮**组成的。§
20295§privilege§ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ§Education is not a privilege of some people but a right of all citizens.§受教育不是某些人的**特权**，而是所有公民的权利。§
20296§infrastructure§ˈɪnfrəstrʌktʃə(r)§How does the port change a city's infrastructure?§港口如何改变一个城市的**基础结构**？§改例句：句末中文问号改为英文问号
20297§allocate§ˈæləkeɪt§The world-wide coal industry allocates extensive resources to researching and developing new technologies.§全球的煤炭业为新技术的研发**提供**了广泛的资源。§
20298§qualification§ˌkwɒlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§You can select someone—even a friend—who has the qualifications, degrees and certificates.§你可以选有**资格**、学位和证书的人，甚至可以是朋友。§
20299§expand§ɪkˈspænd§The goal of university should be to expand the minds of students.§大学的目标应该是**开阔**学生的视野。§
20300§trap§træp§The parents were a bit concerned about the side bar of the baby chair, because they felt babies could trap their fingers in it.§父母有点担心这个婴儿座椅的侧板，因为他们觉得侧板会**夹住**婴儿的手指。§
20301§intern§ɪnˈtɜːn§Helen worked as an intern in that hospital last year.§海伦去年在那家医院**实习**。§
20302§repaint§riːˈpeɪnt§The first thing people will see when they go in is that the foyer has been repainted gold.§人们走进来首先就会看到门廊被**重新漆**成了金色。§
20303§specialist§ˈspeʃəlɪst§The professor is one of the world's leading specialists in the field.§这位教授是该领域内的顶级**专家**。§
20304§migratory§ˈmaɪɡrətri§There are lots of birds in this national forest park, both resident and migratory.§这个国家森林公园里有很多鸟，有留鸟也有**候鸟**。§
20305§inlet§ˈɪnlet§There are a thousand little inlets and backwaters all through here.§这里共有上千个小**水湾**和死水潭。§
20306§nutrition§njuˈtrɪʃn§Females are more conscious of food nutrition.§女性更关注食品**营养**。§改例句：作主语的复数名词应为 Females，Female 错
20307§censor§ˈsensə(r)§Should films and television be censored or should we be free to choose what we see?§电影和电视应该接受**审查**还是应该由我们自由选择去看什么？§
20308§widespread§ˈwaɪdspred§The use of friction to make fire was also widespread in Europe.§摩擦生火的办法在欧洲也**广为流传**。§
20309§hazard§ˈhæzəd§Traffic pollution is a major health hazard.§交通污染是主要的健康**公害**。§
20310§rear§rɪə(r)§Mary's office is next to the rear entrance.§玛丽的办公室挨着**后**门。§
20311§shareholder§ˈʃeəhəʊldə(r)§Shareholders voted at the annual meeting to approve the company's plan to invest more in renewable energy.§**股东**们在年会上投票批准了公司加大可再生能源投资的计划。§补例句
20312§bid§bɪd§Those willing to extend the validity of their bid shall be neither required nor permitted to modify it.§那些愿意延长其**投标**有效期的投标人，不需要也不允许修改其投标。§
20313§alight§əˈlaɪt§The earliest peoples probably stored fire by keeping slow burning logs alight or by carrying charcoal in pots.§最原始人类保存火种的方法可能是让缓慢燃烧的原木保持**不灭**，或是将木炭装进罐子里。§
20314§credit§ˈkredɪt§Most historians credit the Chinese with the discovery of gun powder.§大多数历史学家**认为是**中国人发明了火药。§
20315§shrewd§ʃruːd§This politician was passionate and shrewd.§这位政治家富有激情又不失**精明**。§
20316§desert§ˈdezət§The new estates around the city often proved to be windswept deserts because they lacked essential social facilities and services.§城市周边新建的住宅区因缺少基本的社区服务和设施，常常沦落为只有冷风飕飕吹过的**荒凉之地**。§
20317§conclude§kənˈkluːd§They concluded that the children were incapable of deductive reasoning.§他们**得出结论**：儿童没有推理能力。§
20318§explosive§ɪkˈspləʊsɪv§The bomb was packed with several pounds of explosive.§这枚炸弹装有几磅**炸药**。§
20319§inherent§ɪnˈherənt§Women have an inherent love of beauty.§女人**天生**爱美。§

20320§world-wide§ˈwɜːld waɪd§The use of artificial fertilizers world-wide increased by 40 percent per unit of farmed land between the mid 1970s and late 1980s.§从20世纪70年代中期到80年代末，在**全世界范围内**每单位耕地的人造化肥使用量增长了40％。§
20321§grope§grəʊp§The man groped for the light switch in the dark room.§男子在黑洞洞的屋里**摸索**着寻找电灯开关。§
20322§lever§ˈliːvə(r)§He levered a box open to reveal an antique vase.§他**撬开**箱子，里面露出一个古董花瓶。§
20323§ethical§ˈeθɪkl§The behavior is not strictly ethical.§严格来讲，这种行为是不**道德**的。§
20324§improvement§ɪmˈpruːvmənt§His oral English is good, but there's still room for some improvement.§他的英语口语不错，但是还有**提升**的空间。§改例句：be 后作表语应用形容词 good，well 错
20325§vacant§ˈveɪkənt§A vacant room is very difficult to find in this district after nine o'clock.§九点之后，很难在这个区找到**空**房间。§
20326§truant§ˈtruːənt§Jason has been truanting three days this week.§贾森本周**逃**了三天课。§
20327§scandal§ˈskændl§The scandal destroyed the government's image completely.§这件**丑闻**完全毁了政府的形象。§
20328§latent§ˈleɪtnt§He still has latent force to develop in study and research.§在学习和研究方面，他仍有**潜力**可挖。§
20329§tenant§ˈtenənt§The furniture was left by the former tenant.§这些家具是上个**房客**留下来的。§
20330§psychiatric§ˌsaɪkiˈætrɪk§Jim suffered from a psychiatric disorder.§吉姆**精神**紊乱。§
20331§bolster§ˈbəʊlstə(r)§To protect airports near the sea, the coastline is being bolstered with twelve kilometres of sea defences.§为了保护近海的机场，海岸线上**支起**了12千米长的沿海防护栏。§
20332§immigrant§ˈɪmɪgrənt§This immigrant's citizenship was revoked because he had concealed his criminal record.§这位**移民**因为隐瞒了犯罪记录而被取消了国籍。§
20333§sequence§ˈsiːkwəns§Scientists were able to analyse the sequence of events.§科学家能够分析事件发生的**先后顺序**。§
20334§ecosystem§ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm§One tool for assessing the impact of forestry on the ecosystem is population viability analysis (PVA).§种群生存能力分析是评定林业对**生态系统**影响的一种方法。§改例句：中文括号改为英文括号
20335§concern§kənˈsɜːn§What most concerns me is I'm still not doing very well on my homework.§最让我**担心**的是我现在还不能很好地完成家庭作业。§

20336§exotic§ɪɡˈzɒtɪk§Their exotic apparel sets them apart from the locals.§**奇异的**服装将他们与当地人区分开来。§改例句：stand out 是不及物短语，不能说 stands them out from，改为 sets them apart from；改译文：「奇装异服」是成语，exotic 无法单独括出，改为「奇异的服装」
20337§evaporate§ɪˈvæpəreɪt§He thought water could evaporate quickly in sandy soils.§他认为水在砂土中会很快**蒸发**。§
20338§destiny§ˈdestəni§Mark was conscious that music was not his destiny.§马克意识到音乐并不是他的**最终归宿**。§
20339§hide§haɪd§It is improbable that there is a planet hidden behind the sun.§在太阳的背后不可能**藏**着一颗行星。§
20340§former§ˈfɔːmə(r)§The world's food production will move from Western Europe to the former communist countries and parts of the developing world.§世界粮食生产将从西欧转移到**前**社会主义国家和一些发展中国家。§
20341§awful§ˈɔːfl§The food at the restaurant was awful.§这家饭店的食物很**糟糕**。§
20342§sore§sɔː(r)§He's had so many colds and sore throats recently.§他最近常常感冒，嗓子也经常**痛**。§
20343§virtually§ˈvɜːtʃuəli§There is virtually no evidence to support his argument.§**几乎**没有任何证据可以支持他的论点。§改译文：virtually no 是“几乎没有”，原译“事实上”不准确，改为“几乎”
20344§tangibly§ˈtændʒəbli§This improvement, while not tangibly measurable, has increased the ability of management.§这一进步，虽然没法**具体**衡量，但是提高了管理能力。§
20345§windscreen§ˈwɪndskriːn§You must attach it to the front windscreen of your car.§你必须把它贴在汽车前面的**挡风玻璃**上。§
20346§decent§ˈdiːsnt§You can't get anything decent under $15.§花不到15美金不可能买到**像样**的东西。§
20347§alluvial§əˈluːviəl§The seabed here consisted of alluvial silt and mud deposits.§此地的海床由**冲积**到这里的细沙和沉积的淤泥构成。§改译文：“冲击”是“冲积”的错别字
20348§slum§slʌm§Such rapid and uncontrolled growth helped to turn parts of cities into slums.§这种快速而无节制的增长使城市的某些地区变成了**贫民窟**。§
20349§distill§dɪˈstɪl§The vacuum distillation unit distills heavy and light gas oils.§真空蒸馏装置**精炼出**重柴油和轻柴油。§
20350§economical§ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪkl§The government set some policies to help meet the demand for more economical use of land.§政府制定了一些政策，以满足更为**经济**地利用土地的需要。§
20351§medication§ˌmedɪˈkeɪʃn§The doctor writes what medication you need on the prescription.§医生在处方上写了你需要吃的**药**。§
20352§target§ˈtɑːgɪt§Everyone should have a target in mind for the first year of college life.§每个人在大学生活的第一年都应该有个**目标**。§
20353§independent§ˌɪndɪˈpendənt§Mary was an independent-minded student.§玛丽是个有**独立**见解的学生。§
20354§radius§ˈreɪdiəs§Some local carpenters could only accept jobs in a three-kilometer radius.§当地的一些木匠只能接受**方圆**三千米内的工作。§改例句：threekilometer 拼写错，应为 three-kilometer
20355§fossil§ˈfɒsl§Fuel produced from crop residues is rarely competitive with fossil fuels at the present time.§由农作物残渣制成的燃料目前还不具备与**矿物**燃料竞争的实力。§
20356§shade§ʃeɪd§Dark colours give an aura of authority while lighter pastel shades suggest approachability.§深色调给人一种权威的感觉，而清淡柔和的**色调**使人感到亲切。§

20357§wean§wiːn§It is hard to wean children off picture books when pictures have played a major part throughout their reading experiences.§当图画在孩子们的阅读中扮演着主要角色时，很难让他们**戒掉**图画书，去阅读不带图画的书籍。§改译文：原译没有和 wean off（使戒掉）对应的词，补“戒掉图画书，”
20358§comprise§kəmˈpraɪz§The hotel comprises 82 one-bedroom apartments and 12 suites.§这家酒店**有**82间单人床位的公寓和12间套房。§
20359§stable§ˈsteɪbl§The society will remain stable over the long term.§社会将保持长期**稳定**。§
20360§disappointing§ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪŋ§The students find the exhibition disappointing.§学生们觉得这个展览**令人失望**。§
20361§delta§ˈdeltə§River deltas are difficult places for map makers.§河流**三角洲**地带是让地图绘制者感到头疼的地方。§
20362§urban§ˈɜːbən§The concentration of vehicles makes air quality in urban areas unpleasant.§汽车大量集中在**市**区，使得这里的空气污浊不堪。§
20363§compliment§ˈkɒmplɪmənt§Thank you for your compliments.§谢谢你的**称赞**。§
20364§execution§ˌeksɪˈkjuːʃn§The manager had failed in the execution of her duty.§经理未能**履行**职责。§
